title.zh: 将南甘马粦省 Lagonoy 市镇 Himanag 描笼涯的 Balaton 国立中学附属校分离，改设为独立的 Himanag 国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Balaton National High School - Himanag Annex in Baran Gay Himanag, Municipality of Lagonoy, Province of Camarines Sur From the Balaton National High School, Converting It Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as Himanag National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Balaton National High School - Himanag Annex in Baran Gay Himanag, Municipality of Lagonoy, Province of Camarines Sur From the Balaton National High School, Converting It Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as Himanag National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Himanag của Trường Trung học Balaton Quốc gia tại Đô thị Lagonoy, Tỉnh Camarines Sur khỏi Trường Trung học Balaton Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Himanag Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Himanag ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Balaton แห่งชาติในเทศบาล Lagonoy จังหวัด Camarines Sur ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Balaton แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Himanag แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Himanag, Sekolah Menengah Balaton Nasional di Kotamadya Lagonoy, Provinsi Camarines Sur dari Sekolah Menengah Balaton Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Himanag Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Himanag, Sekolah Menengah Balaton Kebangsaan di Perbandaran Lagonoy, Wilayah Camarines Sur daripada Sekolah Menengah Balaton Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Himanag Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: Separation and Conversion into a National High School. - The Balaton National High School – Himanag Annex in Barangay Himanag, Municipality of Lagonoy, Province of Camarines Sur is hereby separated from the Balaton National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as Himanag National High School.

Transfer of Assets and Liabilities. - All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Balaton National High School - Himanag Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Himanag National High School.

Appropriations. - The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the Himanag National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Balaton National High School – Himanag Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. - The Secretary of Education shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
